audience: teams that run business apps, tables and reports on Quickbase

useCases.title: Explore the tables of an app
useCases.text: List the tables of an app, then read the fields of one table to learn their ids.

useCases.title: Query records with a filter
useCases.text: Query a table with a where clause and a sort order. Read more pages with skip and top.

useCases.title: Run a saved report
useCases.text: List the reports of a table, then run one and read its rows.

useCases.title: Insert or update records
useCases.text: Insert new records, or update existing ones that match a unique key field. Writes change live data.

useCases.title: Check a formula before you use it
useCases.text: Evaluate a formula against a table, optionally for one record. Nothing is saved.
